title: 语音语言模型中决策规则错位与读出覆盖限制的分离
summary: 本文提出一种生成对齐的诊断阶梯，用于分离语音语言模型在副语言任务中的端点、决策规则和读出覆盖差距。实验表明，状态解码平均比生成高27.8个准确率点，且决策规则和读出覆盖差距均为正。无标签逻辑校正可改善生成准确率，表明部分差距可操作。
summary_en: This paper introduces a generation-aligned diagnostic ladder to separate endpoint, decision-rule, and readout-coverage gaps in speech language models. Experiments show state decoding exceeds generation by 27.8 accuracy points on average, and both gaps are positive. Label-free logit correction improves generated accuracy, indicating actionable gaps.
